profile.headline: Software Engineer at Arista Networks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working as a Software Engineer in Packet Forwarding Engines (PFE) software development team.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Protocol Infrastructure software development for next generation Brocade Data Center Ethernet platforms XPLIANT, broadcom

Currently working in VxLAN Layer 2/Layer 3 forwarding area for data center solution compliant to BGP-EVPN RFC 7432.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Protocol Infrastructure software development for next generation Brocade Data Center Ethernet platforms.

Currently working in VxLAN-l2 forwarding area. Worked on multiple features like, L2 Forwarding, which maintains and programs l2 forwarding database and in brocade VCS distributes same in cluster and keep it in sync across cluster, L2 and L3 Access Control Lists (ACLs), which is a security feature, and provisioning High Availability for protocol infrastructure software modules, SPAN/RSPAN which is very handy debugging feature.

positions.title: Research Assistant and System Administrator, IIT Bombay
positions.description:
Gained exposure and developed proficiency to skills involved in the maintenance and troubleshooting of wired and wireless local area networks, including configuration of network switches and wireless access points.
Successfully migrated 2100 users from NIS and password archives to LDAP directory and integrated it with email server of EE department.
Responsible for the maintenance and upgrade of workstations in PC Lab, a general purpose computing facility for students of the department.

projects.title: Intelligent Edge Device Implementation for Scalable Video Applications: Multicast with Quality
projects.description:
The project involves implementation of modified PIM-SM protocol which will piggyback QoS aspect of end user video quality and integrating it with forwarding plane of H.264/SVC.
H.264/SVC will extract different video quality on the base of end user requirement.
Worked on XORP and Quagga Software Routing Suites.
Modified Quagga pimd module and IGMPv3 code of Linux kernel and compiled the kernel on several Linux distributions to carry QoS aspect of video quality.

projects.title: MPLS Traffic Engineering Algorithms for Efficient Network Utilization
